reviewed_by: Codex focused review for diagnostics sink self-recovery
reason: The change tracks transient write failures per diagnostics sink and clears degradation only after the exact failed destination accepts a later write. A bounded background probe makes recovery autonomous when no new diagnostic targets that sink. The selection covers retained aggregate failures, exact-sink recovery for both feature and aggregate destinations, and recovery by the autonomous probe.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Frontend, Rust/native code, browser/device behavior, API response shape, provider and harness runtimes, chat lifecycle, and database persistence are unchanged. The live Core restart and authenticated localhost/LAN health checks cover the operator-visible recovery baseline; this branch changes only diagnostics manager state reconciliation.
